# Reference data

The JSON side of the API: leagues, teams, players and games. The datasets
key on these ids (a game id in the URL, team and player UUIDs in the
columns), and the game record itself — schedule, teams, score, venue,
game-time weather — lives here.

> **Current state, not history.** Every reference row is the latest value,
> refreshed a few times an hour, and earlier values are not kept: a game's
> `status`, `home_score` / `away_score`, `current_period` and the line-score
> arrays move while it is live and are final once `status` is `COMPLETED`;
> a postponed game shows its new `start_time` and the reason; a traded
> player's `current_team_id` changes. For how a game's state evolved over
> time use `game-state-timeline`; for its odds history use `sportsbook-lines`.
> Never present a game's score fields as a timeline.

All four need a key, return JSON, and paginate with `{data, next_cursor}`
(`/v1/leagues` always fits one page). The CLI and SDK paginate for you and
return complete lists of plain dicts; `--format json|jsonl|csv|record` carry
every field, the default `games` table is a curated subset (`--wide` shows all).

## leagues

One row per supported league; `code` is the value every `league` filter takes.

| | |
|---|---|
| Endpoint | `GET /v1/leagues` |
| CLI | `betflux leagues` |
| Python | `bf.leagues()` |
| Filters | none |

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | `string` | no | League code, e.g. NBA — the value every `league` filter takes. |
| `name` | `string` | no | Full league name, e.g. National Basketball Association. |

## teams

One row per canonical team; `id` is the UUID behind the datasets' `home_team_id` / `away_team_id`, `name` is what the `team` filter matches.

| | |
|---|---|
| Endpoint | `GET /v1/teams` |
| CLI | `betflux teams --league NBA` |
| Python | `bf.teams(league="NBA")` |
| Filters | `league` |

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | no | Canonical team UUID — stable across seasons. |
| `league` | `string` | no | League code the team plays in. |
| `name` | `string` | no | Canonical full team name, e.g. Miami Heat (the value `team` filters match). |
| `short_name` | `string` | no | Short display name, e.g. Heat. |
| `abbreviation` | `string` | no | League abbreviation, e.g. MIA. |
| `city` | `string` | yes | Home city; null when not tracked. |
| `conference` | `string` | yes | Conference, e.g. Eastern; null where the league has none. |
| `division` | `string` | yes | Division, e.g. Southeast; null where the league has none. |
| `is_active` | `boolean` | no | False for defunct or relocated franchises. |

## players

One row per canonical player; `id` is the UUID behind the datasets' `*_player_ids` and the `player_id` filter.

| | |
|---|---|
| Endpoint | `GET /v1/players` |
| CLI | `betflux players --league NBA --team-id <team-uuid>` |
| Python | `bf.players(league="NBA", team_id=...)` |
| Filters | `league`, `team_id` |

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | no | Canonical player UUID (matches closing-lines `*_player_ids` and the `player_id` filter). |
| `league` | `string` | no | League code the player belongs to. |
| `first_name` | `string` | no | First name. |
| `last_name` | `string` | no | Last name. |
| `position` | `string` | yes | Position code, e.g. PG, QB; null when unknown. |
| `jersey_number` | `integer` | yes | Current jersey number; null when unknown. |
| `current_team_id` | `string` | yes | UUID of the player's current team; null for free agents. |
| `is_active` | `boolean` | no | False once the player is out of the league. |

## games

One row per game: the public `id` every per-game endpoint takes plus the game record — schedule, teams, score, venue, weather.

| | |
|---|---|
| Endpoint | `GET /v1/games` · `GET /v1/games/{game_id}` |
| CLI | `betflux games --league NBA --date-from 2026-04-01 --date-to 2026-04-07` · `betflux games --id <game_id> --format record` |
| Python | `bf.games(league="NBA", date_from="2026-04-01", date_to="2026-04-07")` · `bf.game("<game_id>")` |
| Filters | `league`, `date_from`, `date_to`, `team`, `status` |

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | no | Game id (e.g. NBA_GSW_MIA_20250408). |
| `league` | `string` | no | League code, e.g. NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, NCAAM, NCAAF. |
| `game_date` | `string` | no | Eastern-Time calendar date of the scheduled start (matches closing-lines game_date). |
| `start_time` | `string` | no | Scheduled start, ISO 8601 UTC. |
| `status` | `string` | no | Schedule status, e.g. SCHEDULED, STARTED, COMPLETED. |
| `is_live` | `boolean` | no | True while the game is in progress. |
| `home_team` | `string` | no | Canonical home team name. |
| `home_team_abbr` | `string` | no | Home team abbreviation, e.g. MIA. |
| `home_team_id` | `string` | no | Canonical home team UUID (matches /v1/teams ids). |
| `away_team` | `string` | no | Canonical away team name. |
| `away_team_abbr` | `string` | no | Away team abbreviation, e.g. GSW. |
| `away_team_id` | `string` | no | Canonical away team UUID (matches /v1/teams ids). |
| `season` | `string` | yes | Season slug the game belongs to, e.g. 2026-regular. |
| `season_type` | `string` | yes | PRESEASON, SEASON (regular) or POSTSEASON. |
| `end_time` | `string` | yes | Observed end, ISO 8601 UTC; null until known (often never set). |
| `week` | `integer` | yes | Schedule week (NFL, NCAAF); null for other leagues. |
| `is_neutral_venue` | `boolean` | no | True when neither team is the venue's home side. |
| `delayed_or_postponed_reason` | `string` | yes | Reason while status is DELAYED or POSTPONED; null otherwise. |
| `broadcasters` | `string[]` | no | Broadcast outlets; empty when unknown. |
| `attendance` | `integer` | yes | Reported attendance; null until posted. |
| `home_score` | `integer` | yes | Home score so far; final once status is COMPLETED. Null before tip-off. |
| `away_score` | `integer` | yes | Away score so far; final once status is COMPLETED. Null before tip-off. |
| `current_period` | `integer` | yes | Quarter / inning / period / half in progress; null before the game and after it ends. |
| `current_period_seconds_remaining` | `integer` | yes | Clock seconds left in the current period (timed sports); null otherwise. |
| `current_period_half` | `string` | yes | TOP or BOTTOM of the current inning (MLB); null elsewhere. |
| `current_intermission` | `string` | yes | Label for a break in play (e.g. HALFTIME); null while play is on. |
| `period_scores_home` | `integer[]` | no | Home line score, one entry per completed or in-progress period. |
| `period_scores_away` | `integer[]` | no | Away line score, index-aligned with period_scores_home. |
| `venue_id` | `string` | yes | Venue UUID; null when no venue is known. |
| `venue_name` | `string` | yes | Venue name, e.g. Truist Park. |
| `venue_city` | `string` | yes | Venue city with its region, e.g. Atlanta, GA. |
| `venue_country` | `string` | yes | Venue country, e.g. USA. |
| `venue_latitude` | `number` | yes | Venue latitude (WGS84). |
| `venue_longitude` | `number` | yes | Venue longitude (WGS84). |
| `venue_capacity` | `integer` | yes | Largest sports capacity of the building. |
| `venue_surface` | `string` | yes | Playing surface, e.g. Kentucky Bluegrass, FieldTurf; null when unknown. |
| `venue_has_roof` | `boolean` | yes | True for covered venues (domes and arenas). |
| `venue_has_retractable_roof` | `boolean` | yes | True when the roof can open. |
| `weather_type` | `string` | yes | Weather category at game time, e.g. SUNNY, CLOUDY, LIGHT_RAIN; null indoors or when unavailable. |
| `weather_description` | `string` | yes | Free-text weather description, e.g. sky is clear. |
| `weather_temperature_f` | `number` | yes | Temperature in °F. |
| `weather_wind_speed_mph` | `number` | yes | Wind speed in mph. |
| `weather_wind_direction_degrees` | `integer` | yes | Wind origin bearing in degrees. |
| `weather_wind_direction_label` | `string` | yes | Compass label for the wind origin, e.g. WSW. |
| `weather_precipitation_type` | `string` | yes | RAIN, SNOW, … when precipitation is forecast; null otherwise. |
| `weather_precipitation_percent` | `integer` | yes | Precipitation probability in percent. |
| `weather_humidity_percent` | `integer` | yes | Relative humidity in percent. |
